image_description: A low-angle shot of two street signs mounted on a metal pole against a bright, overcast sky. The primary sign is green with white text reading 'CICERO' and 'WILLOWBROOK'. A secondary, partially visible sign above it appears to be blue or dark green. Snow covers the tops of evergreen trees in the lower left foreground. Power lines traverse the upper portion of the frame.
